items.title: What Capital One Financial (COF)'s Eurobond Issuance Means For Shareholders
items.summary: Earlier this month, Capital One Financial completed two euro-denominated fixed-income offerings, issuing €750 million fixed-to-floating rate notes due 2032 and another €750 million tranche due 2037, both senior, unsecured, callable Eurobonds with variable coupons priced at 100%. By tapping the euro bond market with these long-dated, variable-rate issues, Capital One Financial is diversifying its funding base and adding flexibility to how it manages its debt profile over time.
